name: StateJar memory
description: Verifiable memory: typed facts with one value per field, append-only versions, recall of only what a turn needs with the handle (shm_...) of the state it came from, and an audit trail of every disclosure.

cliCommands.name: statejar
cliCommands.description: Set up and inspect StateJar memory (init, status, search, add, list, forget, export)

scope.description: The scope (session) in your StateJar account this plugin reads and writes.

autoRecall.description: Before each turn, add the memory the message needs.

autoCapture.description: Queue the user's messages (secrets removed) and send them in batches.
